# `.agents/skills/` — On-Demand Workflow Contract

## Purpose

Skills are progressive-loaded procedures. Discovery metadata stays short; detailed references and scripts load only when the skill is selected.

## Selection

- Use `context-orchestration` for context packets, project planning, task checkpoints, handoffs, and orchestration.
- Use `orchestrate-subagent-masters` for bounded multi-agent dispatch and evaluator rounds.
- Use `typesafe-jev` for calibrated routing, reranking, faithfulness, and retrieval decisions.
- Use `code-security`, `llm-security`, `production-security`, and `pqc-secrets` for security-sensitive changes.
- Use domain skills only when their trigger matches; do not load every skill for every task.

## Shared invariants

Every skill must define a bounded procedure, explicit stop conditions, verification, and references relative to its own directory. Skills never store secrets, silently downgrade errors, or mutate shared ledgers on behalf of a subagent.

## Child DOX index

- [`context-orchestration/`](./context-orchestration/) — compact context and task lifecycle.
- [`orchestrate-subagent-masters/`](./orchestrate-subagent-masters/) — multi-agent topology and receipts.
- [`typesafe-jev/`](./typesafe-jev/) — typed decision contract.
- [`../templates/egm-design.md`](../templates/egm-design.md) — design artifact for Elephant/Goldfish review.
- Security packs: [`code-security/`](./code-security/), [`llm-security/`](./llm-security/), [`production-security/`](./production-security/), [`pqc-secrets/`](./pqc-secrets/).
